hero.title: Income Prediction
hero.subtitle: Above 50K, or not.
hero.tagline: A notebook that fits three classifiers on adult.csv, pickles gradient boosting, and a Flask form that returns >50K or <=50K.
hero.impact: The form sends 12 fields. The app reshapes them to one row and reads the pickled GradientBoostingClassifier.

problems.d: adult.csv is the income table. The notebook drops fnlwgt and educational-num, and fills ? with the most common value in that column.
LabelEncoder maps workclass, education, marital status, occupation, relationship, race, gender, country, and income to integers.
Random forest, gradient boosting, and AdaBoost each train on a 70/30 split. ROC curves are plotted. model.pkl is the gradient boosting fit.

problems.t: A form instead of a notebook
problems.d: Twelve inputs — age through country — post to /predict. Output 1 is >50K. Output 0 is <=50K.
